intro: Professionals and everyday users convert pounds (lb) to ounces (oz) when working across imperial and imperial standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One pound (avoirdupois) equals 16 ounces, while 1 ounce equals 0.0625 pounds. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Precious Metal Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Standard grocery and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Gold, silver, and platinum bullion use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.
Never confuse dry weight ounces (oz) with liquid volume fluid ounces (fl oz); they only match numerically for pure water at standard density.

faqs.question: How many ounces (oz) are in 1 pound (avoirdupois) (lb)?
faqs.answer: There are 16 ounces (oz) in 1 pound (avoirdupois) (lb), which rounds to 16 oz for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 ounce equals 0.0625 pounds.

faqs.question: How do I convert pounds to ounces (lb to oz)?
faqs.answer: To convert pounds to ounces, use the formula: oz = lb × 16. For example, converting 25 lb gives 400 oz.

faqs.question: What is 25 pounds in ounces?
faqs.answer: 25 pounds (lb) equals exactly 400 ounces (oz) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
